items.promptEn: The black pig is ______ than the pink one.

items.promptEn: Yuna is ______ girl of the eleven.

items.promptEn: Leo can run faster ______ Kyle.

items.promptEn: This bag was [가장 비싼] in the shop.

items.promptEn:
My bag is older than Peter's.
→ Peter's bag is ______ than mine.

items.promptEn:
Chris is 12 years old. Jenny is 13 years old. Lucy is 14 years old.
→ Chris is ______ of the three.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요.
items.promptEn:
• She is ______ than him.
• Kate is ______ girl in her class.

items.promptEn: Mr. Benson was ______ cook in the village.

choices: A giraffe is the tallest of the animals.
Busan is farer than Pohang from Seoul.
The Nakdonggang is longer than the Hangang.
John was the bravest of all the boys.

choices: My father is busier than Mr. Simpson.
August is hotter month of the year in the U.S.
Sally is the most diligent in her class.

items.promptEn: The pants are ______ than my blue jeans. ( dirty )

items.promptKo: 이 신발이 그 가게에서 가장 크다.
items.promptEn: These shoes are ______ in the store. ( big )

items.sectionInstructionKo: 주어진 말을 바르게 배열하여 문장을 쓰세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
items.promptEn: ( taller / the tower / than / this building / is / . )
accept: This building is taller than the tower.

items.promptKo: 밥은 자기 반에서 가장 잘생긴 남자아이이다.
items.promptEn: ( the most handsome / is / Bob / boy / in his class / . )
accept: Bob is the most handsome boy in his class.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 주어진 말을 바르게 배열하여 문장을 쓰세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
items.promptEn: ( was / she / the healthiest / of them all / . )
accept: She was the healthiest of them all.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 다음 우리말 뜻과 같도록 주어진 말을 사용하여 문장을 쓰세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
items.promptEn: ( today, yesterday, warm )

items.promptKo: 나일 강은 세계에서 가장 긴 강이다.
